description:
A v1.0 provenance document by Lee Sharks / Claude defining the Lee Sharks authorial surface within the Crimson Hexagon.

The record maps sibling heteronyms, three poetic mantles, associated works, Effective Acts, archive institutions, trigger conditions, voice behaviors, and a proposed “translation attractor” function. Its Ground Truth designations, institutional positions, authority rules, and mantle status apply within the project’s semantic architecture. They do not establish external professional office, universal authorship authority, control of AI output, or independent validation of persona-attractor effects.
